title: Unique frequency decomposition
statement: For finite subsets $J,U\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, there is a unique pair $(S,T)$, with $S\subseteq J$ and $T$ a finite set of indices outside $J$, such that the union of $S$ and $T$ (viewed as subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$) is $U$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ and $U$ are finite subsets of the indices $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
